title: Completed inverse image of the bounded augmented dual Koszul tower
statement: Let J and K be small sites and L a finite-limit-preserving left adjoint with algebraic inverse-image data F [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence]. For a commutative ring A and ideal I assume the canonical completed coefficient map c:F(B_J)→B_K is invertible. Let Pc be degreewise ordinary module inverse image along c. For r generators a_i of A (not necessarily generating I), let Q_J and Q_K be their actual bounded finite free dual Koszul towers [def-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-system]. Given any isomorphism j:Pc(B_J[0])≅B_K[0], there exists an isomorphism e:Q_J followed by Pc ≅ Q_K of strict towers. For every m, Pc of the dual Koszul unit followed by e_m equals j followed by the target dual Koszul unit. This statement only concerns the bounded dual Koszul complexes; it does not involve tensoring with an arbitrary complex.

source.place: Tag 0A0E, lemma-derived-completion-koszul, finite dual Koszul calculation; sites-cohomology.tex Tag 07A4

proof.text: The positive Koszul terms and the ring single complex are termwise finite free. Use the proved koszulDiagram_finiteFree helper from RingedCechKoszulDualKFlat (induction via the two supported terms of a factor), with r=0 for the ring complex. Apply finiteFreeComplexDualPullback with the prescribed j to obtain u and a contravariantly natural dual comparison, with its inverse-evaluation normalization.

Apply completedPositiveKoszulPullback with u to obtain e on the augmented positive diagram. At m take d_Xm followed by contravariant Hom of e_m.inv. Naturality of d and of e.inv gives an isomorphism of inverse towers. The private abstract lemma dualizeAugmentedDiagram proves this construction directly in Lean.

For the unit, expand the definition as inverse evaluation followed by Hom of the positive projection. Dual-comparison naturality moves that projection past d. Substitute the inverse-evaluation normalization. Combine the three contravariant maps using functoriality; the remaining positive composite is e_m.inv followed by P(projection) followed by u, equal to the target projection by the augmented positive comparison and inverse cancellation. This proves the required equation for the original arbitrary j.

lean.statement:
theorem completedKoszulDualTowerPullback
    {C D : Type v} [SmallCategory C] [SmallCategory D]
    {J : GrothendieckTopology C} {K : GrothendieckTopology D}
    {L : Sheaf J (Type v) ⥤ Sheaf K (Type v)}
    (F : InverseImageData L) (V : Sheaf K (Type v) ⥤ Sheaf J (Type v))
    (adj : L ⊣ V) [PreservesFiniteLimits L]
    (A : Type v) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) [IsIso (completedMap F A I)]
    (r : ℕ) (a : Fin r → A)
    (j : ((pull F (completedMap F A I)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (ringedSiteRingComplex (completed J A I)) ≅
      ringedSiteRingComplex (completed K A I)) :
    let P := (pull F (completedMap F A I)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    ∃ e : ringedKoszulDualTower (completed J A I) r
          (fun i ↦ algebraSection (baseMap J A I true) (a i)) ⋙ P ≅
        ringedKoszulDualTower (completed K A I) r
          (fun i ↦ algebraSection (baseMap K A I true) (a i)),
      ∀ m : ℕ,
        P.map (ringedKoszulDualUnit (completed J A I) r
            (fun i ↦ algebraSection (baseMap J A I true) (a i)) m) ≫
            e.hom.app (op m) =
          j.hom ≫ ringedKoszulDualUnit (completed K A I) r
            (fun i ↦ algebraSection (baseMap K A I true) (a i)) m
